text:
A wide shot inside a sunlit cave, continuing from the image: the red dragon sits upright on the mound of gold coins, its wings half raised. The camera slowly pushes in toward the dragon's head. The dragon's scales are deep red with darker ridges along the spine, its curved horns are pale gold, and its long tail curls down over the heaped coins, silver goblets and scattered jewels. Pale stalactites hang from the cave roof, sunlight pours in from an opening at the back, and a clear stream runs along the bottom of the frame between banks of small white and purple flowers. The dragon spreads its wings fully upward and outward until they span the frame, coins sliding down the mound toward the water as its weight shifts, then lowers its head and neck toward the camera and the stream, its amber eyes half closing and its nostrils flaring, and holds still while dust drifts down through the beams of light. Warm golden light against cool shadow in the cave, photorealistic fantasy, fine detail on the scales and the metal of the coins.
<AUDCAP>Gold coins slide and clink loudly down the pile, the dragon's leathery wings creak and flap open, the dragon breathes out in a low rumble, and water trickles in the stream.<ENDAUDCAP>
